LEARN MORE

No Barrier Workflow Execution


Cloud Scale
Your scalable quality foundation

The Functionize Automation Cloud is your all-in-one unified SaaS platform that eliminates infrastructure overhead and maintenance. Seamlessly integrate functional and visual automation into a single, cohesive platform—saving time and costs while scaling effortlessly!

LEARN MORE
Cross Browser
Seamless device compatibility

Effortlessly execute hundreds of workflows concurrently across various platforms, ensuring comprehensive automation coverage. Empower your team to manage platform-specific requirements and dependencies with ease, streamlining operations across diverse environments.

LEARN MORE
End-to-End
Automation Beyond the Interface

We bring the most common end-to-end business processes to the cloud and offer a suite of web-based tools to automate beyond just the interface, including databases, file uploads and downloads, APIs and DBs, text messages, emails, and more, ensuring full operational coverage.

LEARN MORE
Mobile Web
Every device scenario covered

Emulate complex environments using cloud-based virtualization. Eliminate the need to maintain costly on-premises infrastructure. Automate workflows across diverse platforms seamlessly without the overhead of managing physical hardware or multiple environments.

LEARN MORE
Visual
Visual validation with human-like perception

From full-page screenshots to individual elements, meticulously inspect every aspect of your UI with computer vision. Detect even the tiniest alterations with precision, all without the hassle of creating separate flows.

LEARN MORE
Data-driven
Cover diverse data-driven scenarios

Simplify your data-driven automation with our powerful Data Management tools. Efficiently manage process data, create reusable workflows, and enhance automation coverage, all while saving time and effort in managing complex, data-driven tasks.

Game-changing Workflow Maintenance

Dynamic Diagnosis
Auto-Generated Workflow Analysis with EAI

Quickly identify issues before they impact operations. Functionize’s EAI-powered analysis of workflow data, logic, processes, and visual elements provides the actionable insights you need for optimal performance and success.

LEARN MORE
Proactive Maintenance
Effortless Workflow Resolution

Leverage AI diagnostics to effortlessly choose the best resolution path for workflow adjustments. Simply select an option from the maintenance suggestions, and watch as the system autonomously re-executes the workflow on your behalf, significantly improving accuracy and efficiency.

Automatic Self-Healing
Workflows that Evolve with Your Processes

Functionize continuously learns from millions of data points collected during each workflow execution in a deep learning neural net. As changes occur in your systems or processes, EAI Agents autonomously update their models, adjust the workflow, and notify you of what has changed—ensuring your automations remain resilient and adaptable.

LEARN MORE
Quick Add Actions
Streamline Adding Actions to Workflows

Eliminate the need to revisit applications just to add steps. Functionize automatically captures and saves essential data for each interaction, allowing you to seamlessly update workflows using visual snapshots from the most recent execution.

LEARN MORE
Smart Screenshots
Edit Workflows with Interactive Screenshots

Add steps to workflows using dynamic screenshots, without revisiting the original process.


Our Smart Screenshot technology offers the fastest way to update workflows—simply select the necessary changes and guide the system on what to add or modify.

LEARN MORE
No code workflow editing
Simplified Workflow Updates

Built-in tools make it easy to customize and update workflows in real-time. Add or suppress steps with live editing. Fine-tune specific attributes using our intuitive editor. Work seamlessly with enhanced control over your automation processes.

LEARN MORE
Documentation
Automated Documentation for Workflows

Generate detailed, real-time documentation for all your workflows. Functionize’s EAI Agents automatically document each step of the process.

LEARN MORE

Intuitive Workflow Management

Clear & simple organization
Stay in complete control

Our rich dashboard gives you full control over all your automated workflows. Monitor the live status of each workflow, organize them into folders, and drill down to see details and per-workflow settings. Copy workflow steps between processes, create orchestrations, define automation plans, and manage bulk actions with ease—all from a single interface.

Orchestration Power
Scale Workflows with Cloud-Driven Parallel Execution

Using orchestrations, scale your workflow automations effortlessly. Whether it’s handling repetitive daily tasks, running workflows across multiple departments, or managing complex data-driven processes, orchestrations give you the power and control you need. Easily view results in the orchestrations, just as you would for individual workflows, for simplified large-scale execution and management.

Rich Integrations

Native Integrations
Easily integrate your existing apps

Boost team collaboration and operational momentum with seamless integration of your existing applications. Our native integrations provide multiple ways to trigger workflow executions from tools like Jenkins. You can also pass execution results to platforms like Jira when creating tasks or tracking issues. Connecting your tools has never been easier.

EXPLORE INTEGRATIONS
Extensions
Customize your tests to interact with external tools

Easily build and reuse code snippets to trigger actions in other tools or generate dynamic data on the fly. Design custom behaviors with pre- or post-actions that can be configured for entire workflows or specific steps, allowing for seamless integration with external systems.

LEARN MORE
APIs
Build custom integrations with rich APIs

The Functionize REST API allows you to extend automation capabilities beyond the UI. Trigger workflows from external tools or share results with other dashboards to enhance team productivity. Our interactive API documentation makes it easy to build custom integrations tailored to your unique business needs.

Enterprise Capabilities
Flexible Deployment Options
Select from Cloud or Private Cloud

We offer multiple deployment options to fit your organization’s needs. Host in the cloud, or deploy on your local servers, or on a private cloud (AWS, Azure, Google). Functionize runs on the latest and greatest MicroK8s (fully containerized Kubernetes) for high-availability and auto-scaling.

Single Sign On
Login easily with SSO

Simplify credential management and support enterprise security by integrating your Functionize account with popular SSO tools. We offer usage-based pricing, which means you can invite an unlimited number of users, reduce administrative overhead and streamline user authentication.

Bulk Management
Easily handle thousands of tests

We built Functionize for enterprise testing. The more the merrier! Our products are designed for more users and more data. Easily create, edit, execute, and review your tests en masse using bulk management features.

Certification
Level Up Your AI-Testing Skills

Our customers have access to a full suite of support and training resources including self-guided AI Certification programs. The 3-course Certification program enables customers to upskill their AI testing capabilities.

LEARN MORE
24x7 Live Support

Our innovative tech is complemented by great 24/7 global support.

Enterprise accounts have a dedicated CSM to ensure uninterrupted service.

SUPPORT PORTAL
Security
We take it seriously

We take a secure-by-design approach overseen by a dedicated team, offer secure connections via web socket tunnels, and follow the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.


We are AICPA SOC2 certified and we perform regular internal and third-party penetration tests.

Ready to
Take Off?

Schedule a demo to see how Functionize is redefining the testing landscape.

Empower your team to achieve superior testing results in record time.
